versions.changelog:
- Initial release of picgo-upload: instantly upload a local image or file to get a shareable, hosted URL via PicGo.
- Designed as the go-to solution for inserting images into docs/markdown or sharing files when no specific destination is named.
- Supports PicGo desktop app (auto-detects if running), PicGo CLI, and falls back to PicGo Cloud with guided login if needed.
- Handles public-link safety: confirms with the user before uploading potentially sensitive non-image files.
- Provides clear output, linking formats adapted to context (bare URL, markdown, or plain link).
- Smart handling of clipboard uploads—only triggers when user intent is explicit.
